pedagogical_depth.justification: Strict L4 met. instructional_balance.justification: Strict L4 met. CRA progression spans the whole week: concrete (estimation button jar, Number Line floor mat, base-ten rods, paper plates with paper cookies, real pizza fraction circles) → representational (ten-frames, base-ten rod drawings, number-line strips, pizza halves vs fourths overlays) → abstract (numerals, equations like 32 = 30+2 = 16+16, fraction notation 1/2 = 2/4). Lesson 3 'Make and Break 50' is the keystone (compose/decompose with the rod-moving move); Lesson 5 'Fair Shares' is the capstone integrating B1.6/B1.7/B1.8 in one play scenario.
